## 5. AI Self-Reflection Report

### 5.1 Strengths of This Pipeline Run
1. **Numerical integrity:** All 20 key numbers verified against canonical sources with 100% accuracy
2. **Terminology consistency:** "knowledge-constrained agent" used as primary term throughout
3. **Honest limitation reporting:** SOTA disclaimers, benchmark contact bias, and protocol deviations all preserved
4. **Comprehensive revision:** All 11 review items addressed with concrete additions
5. **Formal rigor:** 9 definitions, 2 algorithms, 11 equations, proper LaTeX notation

### 5.2 Weaknesses and Limitations
1. **Reference count:** 26 references — slightly below COMPAG typical range (30-40)
2. **No actual figures:** Only placeholders described; actual figure generation not performed
3. **Single-pass revision:** No second round of revision after re-review (pipeline allows but did not require)
4. **Formula originality:** Formulas are domain-appropriate but not derived from first principles or validated against standard references

### 5.3 Recommendations for Future Runs
1. Search for and include 5-10 additional references during Stage 2
2. Generate actual figures using matplotlib/plotly during Stage 2 or Stage 5
3. Run re-review (Stage 3') before finalizing to catch remaining issues
4. Consider using dedicated formula-verification agents for mathematical notation
